descriptionFr: Premiere etape du Mare a Mare Centre. Depart de la cote est, montee soutenue a travers la plaine orientale et les collines boisees jusqu au village de Catastaghju (Serra di Fiumorbu).
descriptionEn: First stage of the Mare a Mare Centre. Departure from the east coast, sustained climb through the eastern plain and wooded hills to the village of Catastaghju (Serra di Fiumorbu).

descriptionFr: Traversee de forets de pins laricio et de chataigniers centenaires. Passage par les bergeries de Capannelle avant la descente vers le village authentique de Cozzano.
descriptionEn: Walk through Laricio pine forests and centuries-old chestnut groves. Pass by the Capannelle sheepfolds before descending to the authentic village of Cozzano.

descriptionFr: Etape courte et accessible. Descente progressive depuis Cozzano par un sentier forestier ombrage vers les sources thermales de Guitera-les-Bains.
descriptionEn: Short and accessible stage. Gradual descent from Cozzano through a shaded forest trail to the thermal springs of Guitera-les-Bains.

descriptionFr: Remontee depuis les thermes de Guitera en direction du village de Zicavo. Alternance forets de hetres et maquis, passage par le col de la Vaccia.
descriptionEn: Climb from the thermal springs of Guitera towards the village of Zicavo. Mix of beech forests and maquis, passing through the Col de la Vaccia.

descriptionFr: Longue etape a travers la haute vallee du Taravo. Traversee de chataigneraies et de villages perches avec panoramas sur les montagnes environnantes.
descriptionEn: Long stage through the upper Taravo valley. Walk through chestnut groves and perched villages with panoramic mountain views.

descriptionFr: Etape vers le village de Bastelica, patrie de Sampiero Corso. Sentier en balcon au-dessus de la vallee du Prunelli avec vues sur le Monte Renoso.
descriptionEn: Stage towards the village of Bastelica, homeland of Sampiero Corso. Balcony trail above the Prunelli valley with views of Monte Renoso.

descriptionFr: Derniere etape en descente vers la mer. Traversee du maquis corse avec apparition progressive du golfe d Ajaccio. Arrivee sur la plage de Porticcio.
descriptionEn: Final stage descending to the sea. Walk through Corsican maquis with the Gulf of Ajaccio gradually appearing. Arrival at Porticcio beach.
